mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have beautiful clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a pleasant temperature of 73 degrees under a full moon.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as National Senior Center Month to celebrate the vital role our senior center plays in community well-being. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on September 8th to review several development projects including new daycare zoning and the final draft of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan.

We have a busy schedule for the next few days. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow brings trivia at Hop Haus, and looking ahead to the weekend, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, the Dane County Farmer's Market on Friday, and the Verona Area Kids Triathlon this Sunday.

In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on August 19, officers responded to North Main Street and Bering Drive for a motor vehicle accident where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations following the collision.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note the store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
